per_question.question: What was the total net revenue in 2024?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_revenue FROM gold.fact_sales WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND STRFTIME('%Y', order_ts) = '2024' LIMIT 200

per_question.question: How many orders did we get in 2025?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.order_id END) AS orders FROM gold.fact_sales AS f JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 LIMIT 200

per_question.question: Top 5 cities by net revenue in 2025
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM gold.fact_sales AS f JOIN gold.dim_customer AS c ON f.customer_sk = c.customer_sk JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 AND f.is_revenue = TRUE GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

per_question.question: Which payment method has the most orders?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM gold.fact_sales WHERE is_revenue = TRUE GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

per_question.question: What is the average order value for UPI vs COD?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(CASE WHEN is_revenue THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_revenue THEN order_id END) AS aov FROM gold.fact_sales WHERE payment_method IN ('UPI', 'COD') GROUP BY payment_method LIMIT 200

per_question.question: Monthly net revenue trend in 2025
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT year_month, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM gold.agg_monthly_category_sales WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month LIMIT 200

per_question.question: Net revenue by category during the Diwali festive season 2024
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM gold.fact_sales AS f JOIN gold.dim_product AS p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2024 AND d.is_festive_season = TRUE AND f.is_revenue = TRUE GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 200

per_question.question: Which category has the highest gross margin percentage?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT category, 100.0 * SUM(gross_margin) / SUM(net_revenue) AS gross_margin_percentage FROM gold.agg_monthly_category_sales GROUP BY category ORDER BY gross_margin_percentage DESC LIMIT 1

per_question.question: What is the cancellation rate by payment method?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT payment_method, 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status = 'Cancelled' THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cancellation_rate FROM gold.fact_sales GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC LIMIT 200

per_question.question: How many customers placed an order in Chennai?
